sbyong gi gzhi'i skabs kyi cho ga dang las rnams rdzogs so// // 7dbyar dang de dang nye ba'i gzhi dgag dbye'i gzhi'i sdom la/ gnas mal dang ni tshul shing dang / /snga ma phyi ma zhag bdun dang / /bzhi bcu dgag dbye gsol ba dang / /bdag dang go bar bya ba'o/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stobs par spro'am/ spro'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stobs pa kyel spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod kyicig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba gnas mal stobs par bskos te/dge slong gnas mal stobs pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stobs so/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi dbyar gyi gnas mal stobs par spro ste/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba gnas mal stobs par bsko na tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba gnas mal stobs par bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba gnas mal stobs par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du thu'adzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/deng dge 'dun kyi dbyar nye bar sgrub pa dbyar zla 'bring po tshe pyebaco lnga lags na/88—1383

gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun kyis deng tshul shing bzhes te sang nang par gnas par khas blang ngo / /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dbyar phyi ma la ni dbyar nye bar bsgrub 1pa dbyar zla tha chungs tshes bco lnga lags na zhes sngags kyi bye brag tu bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba nang mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir 'di lta ste/ gnas ral ba dang / 'drums khupa bcos pa'i slad du sbyin bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dang / zhal ta pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dang / spyod yul gyi grong che ge mo zhes bgyi ba dang / bro g.yog che ge mo zhes bgyi bas dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum gnas par khas blang ngo / /bdag dbyar 'di na ḍa 7mchis shing bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags so/ /dbyar phyi ma la ni dbyar phyi ma zla ba gsum gnas par khas blang ngo zhes sngags kyis bye brag tu bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba nang mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir dbyar snga ma 'uzla ba gsum gnas par khas blangs pa las bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ bgyi ba zhig gi be+ed du dgung bdun mtshams kyi slad rol tu mchi ba dang / deng tshun chad kyi slar ⑤mchi bar byin gyis brlab bo//bdag dbyar 'di na mchis shing bdag thudabyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags so/ /dbyar gyi gzhi'o// //tshe dang ldan pa khyod zhag bzhi bcu byin kyis brlabs te dge 'dun gyi ched la mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'gro bar spro'am/ spro'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba nang mtshams 88—1384

dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum gnas par khas blangs te/bdag dbyar 'di na mchis shing bdag gi dbyar kyi gnas ni 'di lag rmyepa las/bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba zhag bzhi bcu byin kyis brlabs ñdzute/dge 'dun gyi ched la mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang / de tshun chad kyis slar mchi bar spro na thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsal du gsol/ lan gsum du snobazlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag ④dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di nang mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas 'di chodabyar snga ma zla ba gsum du gnas par khas blangs te/'di dbyar 'di na mchis shing 'di'i dbyar gyi gnas 'di lags pa las dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi ched spyol mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang de tshun chad kyis be+er mchi bar dge 'dun las zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis bye dus la bab cing chobazod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod byug dang / 'di dbyar 'di na mchis shing 'di'i dbyar gyi gnas 'di lags pa las dge 'dun gyi ched la mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang / de 1tshun chad slar mchi bar dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la dge 'dun gyis zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsol to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di nang mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum gnas par khas blangs te/ 'di dbyar 'di na mchis shing 'di'i dbyar gyi gnas 'di lags pa las/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bkyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi ched la mtshams kyi 88—1385

slad rol du mchi ba dang de tshun chad kyis las mchi bar ①dge 'dun la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba gsol te/ de'i be+ed du 'di dbyar 'di na mchis shing de'i 3 dbyar gyi gnas 'di lags pa las/ dge 'dun gyi ched la mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang / de tshun chad kyis slar mchi bar dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la dge 'dun gyis zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba gsol na/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba sprul bar tshe dang ldan pa gang dag bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun kyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba sprul lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dbyar dang nye ba'i gzhi'o// //tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bya ba'i dgag dbye yang bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bdag la mthong ba dang thos pa dang dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bkyid do/ /dgag dbye yang brjod do/ /brjod pa yang rig par bgyid do/ /lan gsum du bzlas/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/deng dge 'dun 3dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags la/ gnas ga ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dgag dbye yang bco lnga pa lags te/ gnas ga ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug 88—1386

bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba de dag 1la mthong ba dang thos pa dang dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyi pyadabyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid do/ /dgag dbye yang brjod do/ /brjod pa yang rig par bgyid do/ /lan gsum du ldubazlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags la/ gnas ga ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dgag dbye yang bco lnga pa lags te/ gnas ga ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba de bdag la mthong ba dang thos pa dang dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid do / /dgag dbye yang brjod do/ /brjod pa ngayang rig par bgyid do/ /tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dgag dbye yang bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun chos bzhin du mdzad pa la 'dun pa 'bul lo/ /'dun pa yang brjod do/ /brjod pa yang rig par bgyid do/ /lan gsum du 5bzlas/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol / deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags la/ gnas ga ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal rtseb sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dgag dbye yang bco lnga pa lags te/ gnas ga ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba de dge 'dun chos bzhin du mdzad pa la 'dun pa 'bul lo/ /'dun pa yang brjod do/ /brjod 88—1387

pa yang rig par bgyid do/ /lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags la/gnas ga ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dgag dbye yang bco lnga pa lags te/ gnas ga ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba de dge 'dun chos bzhin du mdzad pa la 'dun pa 'bul lo/ /'dun pa yang brjod do//brjod pa yang rig par bgyi'o lha/ /tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i kyedagag dbye yang bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun chos bzhin du mdzad pa la 'dun pa 'bul lo/ /bdag la mthong ba dang thos pa dang dogs 1pa'i gnas gsum kyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid do/ /'dun pa dang dgag dbye yang brjod ④do//brjod pa yang rig par bkyid do/ /lan gsum du bzlas/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags la/gnas ga ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dgag dbye yang bco lnga pa lags te/ gnas ga ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba de dge 'dun chos bzhin du mdzad pa la 'dun pa thu'abul lo/ /bdag la rngo mthong ba dang thos pa dang dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid do/ /'dun pa dang dgag dbye yang brjod do/ /brjod pa 88byed1388

yang rig par rngubagyid do/ /lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags la/gnas ga ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bkyi ba'i dgag dbye yang bco lnga pa lags te/ gnas ga ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba de dge 'dun chos bzhin du mdzad pa la 'dun krupa 'bul lo/ /bdag la mthong ba dang thos pa dang dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dudabyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid do/ /'dun pa dang dgag dbye yang brjod do/ /brjod pa yang rig par bgyid do/ /tshe dang ldan pa khyod dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye byed par spro'am/ spro'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol / dge slong ming 'di zhes bkyi ba 'di dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang ba mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun kyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par bsko ste/ dge slong dgag dbye bgyid pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba sti'adi dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la trebhedagag dbye bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni gsol ba'o—/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par spro ste/de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par bsko ñtsan/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bkyid par bsko bar/ tshe 88—1389

dang ldan pa gang dag bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bkyi bar ①dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng byedage 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags te/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / deng dge 'dun dgag dbye mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun kyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags la/bdag cag dge 'dun thams cad ni ltung ba dang bcas par gyur na/ gang gi mdun du bdag cag thong ba de chos bzhin du slar bgyi ba bdag cag la dge slong gnas gzhan du mchis la/ dge slong gi mdun du ltung ba de chos bzhin du slar bgyid par spro ba su yang ma mchis na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis deng ltung ba de byin gyis brlabs te dgag dbye mdzad la/ slad kyi byedage slong gi mdun du thong ba de chos bzhin du slar mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag cag dge 'dun thams cad ni rtsang ba la dogs pa dang yid gnyis dang bcas par gyur na/ gang gi mdun du bdag cag ltung ba de chos bzhin du slar bgyi ba bdag cag las dge slong gnas gzhan du mchis la/dge slong mdo sde 'dzin pa dang 'dul ba 'dzin pa rngodang ma mo 'dzin pa rnams la 88—1390

dris te dogs pa dang yid gnyis bsal la thong ba de chos bzhin du be+er bgyid par spro ba su yang ma mchis na gal te dge 'dun gyi lkudus la bab cing bzod na/dge 'dun gyis geganang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dang rngo ltung ba de byin gyis brlabs te dgag dbye mdzad la/ slad kyi 5dge slong mdo sde 'dzin pa dang 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang ma mo 'dzin pa rnams la dris te dogs pa dang yid gnyis bsal la/ ltung ba de chos bzhin du slar mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun kyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag cag dge 'dun thams cad ni ltung ba'i be+ed du rtsod par gyur pa hūṃn/ gal te dge 'dun gyi khudus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis deng thong ba'i slad du rtsod pa 7byin kyis brlabs te dgag dbye mdzad la slad kyi 37dge slong mdo sde 'dzin pa dang 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang ma mo 'dzin pa rnams la dris te rtsod pa zhi bar bgyis la ltung ba de chos bzhin du slar mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa la/ bdag cag dge 'dun thams cad ni thong ba la nges pa nyid ma lags par gyur na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi 9 dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis deng thong ba la nges pa nyid ma lags pa de byin kyis brlabs te dgag dbye mdzad la—/ slad kyi 7dge slong mdo sde 'dzin pa dang 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang ma mo 'dzin pa rnams la dris te nges pa nyid ma lags pa bsal la ltung ba de chos bzhin du slar mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su 88—1391

gsol / deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dgag dbye yang bco lnga pa lags na/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bdag la mthong ba dang thos pa dang dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la gdams su gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su bstan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su gzung du gsol/ thugs brtse ba can tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ ltung ba shes shing mthong na chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin du slar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum du bzlas/thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/'di ltar gnas 'di na dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyis dgag dbye mdzad lags so/ /legs par dgag dbye mdzad do/ /shin tu dgag dbye mdzad do//btsun pa rdzas 'di lta bus kyang dbyar gnas pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyir rung ngo / /de'i 'og tu dge tshul rnams la dgag dbye bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu dge slong 1rnams la'o/ /dge slong bzhi man chad kyis ni byin gyis brlab 2par bya'o/ /deng dge 'dun gyis dgag dbye bco lnga pa yin la/bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba'i 1dgag dbye yang bco lnga pa yin te/bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bya bas ④dgag dbye byin gyis brlab bo/ /gang gi tshe dge 'dun tshogs pa de'i tshe bdag la mthong ba dang thos pa dang dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bya'o/ /lan gsum du bzlas/ dgag dbye'i gzhi'o// //88—1392

bam po brgyad pa/ sra brkyang ① gi gzhi'i sdom la/ sra brkyang gding bar byed pa dang / /'ding dang go byed 'byin pa'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ 'di ltar gnas 'di na dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun kyis gos kyi rnyed pa'i chos gos bgyis pa ñtsha'adi dge 'dun gyis sra brkyang du bzhed na/gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba dang / sbyin pa po rnams kyi sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su spyad pa'i slad du chos gos sra brkyang du bkyis te/ gnas gang du sra brkyang bting bar chos gos rnying pa rnams dang yang mi 'bral na gsar pa rnams dang lta ci smos/ 'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ 'di ltar gnas 'dir dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyis ne+e gos kyi ④rnyed pa'i chos gos bgyis pa 'di dge 'dun gyis ltesra brkyang du bzhes pas—/ de'i slad du 'di lta ste gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba dang / sbyin pa po rnams kyi sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su spyad pa'i slad du dge 'dun gyis chos gos 'di sra brkyang du bgyis te / gnas gang du sra brkyang bting bar chos gos rnying pa rnams dang yang mi 'bral na gsar pa rnams dang lta ci smos te/ chos gos 'di sra brkyang du bgyi bar tshe dang ldan pa gang dag bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis chos gos 'di sra brkyang du bgyis lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi 88—1393

gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi rmyesra brkyang 'ding bar spro'am/ spro'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'ding bar spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyi dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'ding bar bsko ste sna/ dge slong sra brkyang 'ding ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'ding bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bkyi ba 'di dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'ding bar spro na/de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong 1ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'ding bar bsko ste/ dge slong sra brkyang 'ding ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi cesra brkyang 'ding bar 'gyur na/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'ding bar bsko bar tshe dang ldan pa gang dag bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun kyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun kyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bar 7 dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'ding bar bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas 6de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ chos gos 'di ni dge 'dun kyi sra brkyang du blo mthun par bgyis pa lags/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di ni dbyar gnas 88—1394

pa'i dge 'dun gyi ① sra brkyang 'ding bar bskos lags na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun kyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang /'di lta ste gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba dang / sbyin pa po rnams kyi sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su spyad pa'i slad du dge 'dun gyi tsachos gos 'di sra brkyang 'ding ba dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gtod cing sra brkyang 'ding ba dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba chos gos 'dis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun kyi sra brkyang 'ding bar 'gyur te/gnas gang du sra brkyang bting bar chos gos rnying pa rnams dang yang ④mi 'bral na gsar byepa rnams dang lta ci smos/ 'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ chos gos 'di ni dge 'dun gyis snesra brkyang du blo mthun par bgyis pa lags/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni sra brkyang 'ding bar bskos lags te/ 'di lta ste gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba dang / sbyin pa po rnams kyi sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su dpyad pa'i ) slad du bdag sra brkyang 'ding ba dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas chos gos 'di dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang gding bar bgyi'o/ /gnas gang du sra brkyang bting ༄ —bar chos gos rnying pa rnams dang yang mi 'bral na gsar pa rnams dang lta ci smos/ lan gsum du bzlas/gnas brtan nyunam btsun pa'am tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ chos gos 'di ni dge 'dun gyis sra brkyang du blo mthun par bgyis pa lags/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni sra brkyang 'ding bar bskos pa lags te/de'i slad du 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la 88—1395

reg par gnas par bgyi ba dang / sbyin pa po rnams kyi sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su spyad pa'i slad du bdag sra brkyang 'ding nyub dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas chos gos 'di dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang bting lags te/ gnas gang du sra brkyang bting bar chos gos rnying pa rnams dang yang mi 'bral na gsar pa rnams dang lta ci smos/ lan gsum 3bzlas/ legs par bting ngo / /shin tu bting ngo / /'di la rnyed pa dang phan yon gang yod pa de bdag gi yin no/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ 'di ltar gnas 'dir dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis — sra brkyang bting ba las de'i rjes su 'jug pa'i dus rdzogs te/gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab byung bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis jesra brkyang 'byin pa 'amadzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ 'di ltar gnas 'dir dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis sra brkyang bting ba las de'i rjes su 'jug pa'i dus rdzogs te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis 6sra brkyang 'byin na/ sra brkyang 'byin par tshe dang ldan pa gang dag bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shigagang dag mi brjod 7pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste—/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis sra brkyang phyung lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol / 'di ltar gnas 'dir dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis sra brkyang bting ba las chom rkun gyis bcom pa'i dge slong rnams lhags na gal te dge 'dun gyi 3 dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / chom 88—1396

rkun gyis bcom pa'i dge slong rnams la brten te dge 'dun sra brkyang 'byin pa mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol—/ 'di ⑫ ltar gnas 'dir dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis sra brkyang bting ba las chom rkun gyis bcom pa'i dge slong rnams lhags te/ de'i slad du chom rkun gyis bcom pa'i dge slong rnams la brten nas dge 'dun gyis sra brkyang 'byin pa ༄ mdzad na/ chom rkun kyis bcom pa'i dge slong rnams la brten te sra brkyang 'byin par tshe dang ldan pa gang dag bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas chom rkun gyis bcom pa'i dge slong rnams la brtan lcenas dge 'dun gyis sra brkyang phyung lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /sra brkyang gi gzhi'o// //gos kyi gzhi dang nye ba'i gos kyi gzhi'i sdom la/ shi dang nor 'dra snod 'gyed dang / /bcu gsum dang ni rung bya ba/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ 'di ltar gnas 'dir dge slong nye dga' gum na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong nye dga' gum pa'i rdzas bgo bar bgyi ba gum pa'i yo byad chos gos dang chos gos ma lags pa gda' ba dang mi gda' ba byin gyis brlab bo/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ 'di ltar gnas 'dir dge slong gre skyes gum par gyur na/88—1397

gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun kyis dge slong kun dga' bo nor dang 'dra bas dge slong gre skyes gum pa'i rdzas bgo bar bgyi ba gum pa'i yo byad chos gos dang chos gos ma lags pa gda' ba dang mi gda' ba byin gyis brlab bo/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /gos kyi gzhi'o// //ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod dge 'dun gyi snod sbyad 'gyed par chospro'am/spro'o / /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi snod spyad 2'gyed par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi snod spyad 'gyed par bsko ste/ dge slong snod spyad 'gyed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gye snod spyad 'gyed par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi snod spyad 'gyed par spro ste/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dge 'dun kyi snod spyad 'gyed par bsko ste/dge slong snod spyad 'gyed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi snod spyad 'gyed par 'gyur na tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi snod spyad 'gyed par bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bkyi ba 'di 88—1398

dge 'dun lkusnod srud 'gyed par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du bu'adzin to/ /tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i chos gos bgyis lags pa rung ba spyad par 'os pa'i chos gos py-isnam sbyar du byin gyis brlab po/ /lan gsum du bzlas/ thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /de bzhin du bla gos dang / mthang cegos dang / sham thabs dang / sham thabs kyi gzan dang rngul gzan dang / rngul gzan kyi gzan dang / gdong phyis dang / rnag snyegazan dang / g.yan pa dgab pa dang /skra bzed dang / gding ba dang / dbyar gye gos ras chen la yang brjod par bya'o—/ /tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ gos 'di bdag dang krogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa la mkho ba'i yo byad kyi stsogos su byin gyis brlab po//lan gsum du bzlas/ thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i chos gos lhag pa rung bar ma bgyis pa rung bar bgyi bar mu'os pa 'di mkhan po la rung bar bgyi'o/ /mkhan po la yid brtan te bcang bar bgyi'o/ /rkyen ji lta ba bzhin du bgyi'o/ /lan gsum du bzlas/ thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /gos kyi gzhi dang /nye ba'i gos kyi gzhi'o// //sman gyi gzhi dang las kyi gzhi'i sdom la/ sman dang rung ba'i khang pa dang //'dun pa'i gso sbyong bya ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes byebagyi ba'i sman thun tshod du rung ba 'di dag bdag dang tshangs pa mtshungs 1par spyod pa rnams kyir bkyi bar thun tshod du rung bar byin 88—1399

gyis brlab po/ /lan gsum shebhebazlas/ thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /zhag bdun pa dang / 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba dag la yang de bzhin no/ /dge slong lag gi blas rdo bteg pa na de'i dang por gzhi 'di ni dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i khang par 'gyur ba'o snyam du sems bskyed par bya zhing tshig tu yang brjod par bya'o/ /dge slong rab tu mang po dag gis sems bsdu bas tshe dang ldan pa dag gzhi 'di ni dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i khang par 'gyur bar sems sdus byeshig ces sems bsdu bar bya'o/ /dge slong ji snyed der phyin pa thams cad kyis ༄ gzhi 'di ni dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i khang par 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes tshig mthun par 4cig car brjod par bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/gnas thams cad grub pa'am bgyis pa'am lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i khang par bzhed na/gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun kyi choganas thams cad grub pa'am bgyis pa'am lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang 6bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i khang par bgyi'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad grub pa'am bgyis pa'am lags pa nang 7mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i khang par bzhed de/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad grub pa'am bgyis pa'am lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i khang par bgyid 1snan tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gnas thams cad grub pa'am bgyis pa'am lags pa nang 88—1400

mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun kyi rung ba'i khang par bgyi bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyi 1gnas thams cad grub pa'am bgyis pa'am lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun kyi rung ba'i khang par bgyis lags te/ 'di ltar cang snyemi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /sman gyi gzhi'o// //'phags pa dgongs su gsol/ rgyal po'i kun dga' ra ba'i dge slong ma'i dge 'dun mthun pa rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun mthun pa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod pa nyung ngam/ nyam nga ba —chung ngam / bskyod pa yang ngam/ 'tsho'am/ stobs dang ldan nam/ bde ba 'am4/ kha na ma tho ba ma mchis sam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes bsnyun gsol lo/ /zla ba phyed phyed cing gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa gsol lo/ /'dun pa dang gso spyong bgyi bar gsol ba 'debs so/ /gsol ba yang mkhyen par gsol lo/ /las kyi gzhi'o// //phyir bcos 5pa'i gzhi'i sdom la/ gleng dang nan tur bzod pa dang / /mthol dang spo ba rnams dang ni/ /mgu dang dbyung bar bya ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod re lde ri la song ste/ dge slong 'gro makyogs dang nab d+ngha so la dge sbyong gi chos ma yin pa rnam pa mang pos gleng bar spro'am/88—1401

spro'o / /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong gleng ba po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di re lde ri la song ste/ dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab sheso la dge sbyong gi chos ma lags pa mang pos gleng bar spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang /dge 'dun gyis dge slong gleng ba po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab khyeso la gleng bar bsko'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong gleng ba po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di re sde ri la mchis nas dge slong 'akro mgyogs dang nab — —so la dge spyong cegi chos ma lags pa 5rnam pa mang pos gleng bar 'uspro ste/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong gleng ba po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab ṭ+wāṃso la gleng bar bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong gleng ba po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab 87so la gleng bar bsko ba 77bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong gleng ba po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab 1 so la gleng bar bskos lags te / 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong dmar ser can 'di dag 1 ni 'thab krol bgyid pa/ mtshang 'bru bar bgyid pa15/ rtsod par bgyid pa/'gyed par bgyid pa/ rtsod pa'i gzhi bgyid pa lags te/ de dag dge slong rnams la rgyun du rtsod pa'i gzhi bskyed 15pas des na 1 lung mnod pa dang /klag pa dang / kha ton bgyid pa thudang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bgyi 88—/402

ba dang / nang du sems zhi gnas su bgyi ba shor na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong dmar ser can 'thab krol bgyid pa ma btang ba rnams la baspyigs 1pa'i phrin las mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong dmar ser can 'di ni 'thab krol bgyid pa / mtshang rngu'abru bar bgyid pa/ rtsod par bgyid pa/ 'gyed par bgyid pa—/ rtsod pa'i gzhi bgyed pa lags te/ de dag dge slong rnams la rgyun tu rtsod pa'i gzhi skyed snepas/ des na dge 'dun lung mnod pa dang / klag pa dang / kha ton bgyi ba dang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bgyi ba dang /nang du sems zhi gnas su bkyi ba shor na③/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong dmar ser can 'thab krol bgyid pa ma btang ba rnams la bsdigs pa'i phrin las mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong dmar ser can 'thab grol ma btang ba rnams la bsdigs pa'i phrin las mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang snyem gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong dmar ser can 'thab krol bgyid pa ma btang ba rnams la bsdigs pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/'di ltar cang mi gsung bas trede de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong dmar ser can 'thab krol bgyid pa/mtshang 'bru bar bgyid pa/ rtsod par bkyid pa/ 'gyed par bgyid pa/rtsod pa'i gzhi bgyid pa lags pas/ dge 'dun gyis bdag la bsdigs pa'i 88—1403

phrin las mdzad lags te/ bdag dge slong dmar ser can bsdogs pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pas skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la spu snyol bar bgyid/ 'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs hūṃpar nye bar ston la/mtshams kyi nang du mchis te bzod pa gsol zhing 'thab krol bgyid pa de yang spong na/ thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ bdag dge slong dmar ser can bsdigs pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun nga/ rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong dmar ser can 'di 'thab krol bgyid pa/mtshang 'bru bar bgyid pa/ rtsod par bgyid pa/ 'gyed par bgyid pa/rtsod pa'i gzhi bgyid pa lags pas 'thab krol bgyid pa ma btang ba 'di la dge 'dun gyis bsdigs pa'i 2phrin las mdzad lags te/ 'di bsdigs pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pas skra 'greng bar gyur —/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing / dge 'dun la spu snyol bar bkyid/ 'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la mtshams kyi nang du mchis te/ bzod pa gsol zhing 'thab krol bkyid pa de yang spong ngo zhes mchi na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong dmar ser can baspyigs pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad 4do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong dmar ser can ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di 'thab chokrol bkyid pa/ mtshang 'bru bar bgyid pa/ rtsod par bgyid pa/ 'gyed par bgyid pa/ rtsod pa'i gzhi bgyid pa lags pas 'thab krol bgyid pa ma btang ba 'di la dge 'dun gyis 88—1404

bsdigs pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ 'di bsdigs 1pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pas skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la spu snyol bar bgyid/ 'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la mtshams kyi nang du mchis te bzod pa gsol bye zhing 'thab krol bgyid pa de yang spong ste/de'i slad du dge slong dmar ser can ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun gyis bsdigs pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong dmar ser can bsdigs pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la bzod pa mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/de bzhin du 5lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun kyis dge slong dmar ser can bsdigs pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa ming 'di zhes bgye ba la bzod pa mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong dge ldan ltung ba rgyun tu bgyid pa 'di thudage 'dun lhag ma'i thong ba rgyun du bgyid de/ 'di la dge 'dun gyis spo 5ba dang /gzhi nas spo dzib dang / mgu bar bgyi ba 7dang / gzhi nas 8mgu bar bgyi ba sprul ba dang 'byin pa mdzad pas/ lung mnod pa dang / klag pa dang /kha ton bgyi ba dang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bgyi ba dang / nang du sems zhi gnas su bgyi ba shor na/ gal te dge 'dun kyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong dge ldan ldung ba rgyun du bgyid pa la smad pa'i phrin las mdzad do/ /'di 88—1405

ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ 1dge slong dge ldan ltung ba rgyun tu bgyid pa 'di dge 'dun lhag ma'i thong ba rgyun du bgyid de / 'di la dge 'dun gyis spo 5ba dang gzhi nas spo rngub dang / mgu bar bgyi ba dang gzhi nas mgu bar bgyi ba stsol ba dang 'byin pa mdzad pas lung mnod pa dang / klag pa dang / kha ton bgyi ba dang / rnal 'byor dang /yid la bgyi ba dang / nang du sems zhi gnas su bgyi ba shor te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong dge ldan ltung ba rgyun du bgyid pa la smad pa'i phrin las mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong dge ldan ltung ba rgyun du bgyid pa la smad pa'i phrin las mdzad de/ bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong dge ldan ltung ba rgyun du bgyid pa la smad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong dge ldan ltung ba rgyun du 'byin pa la dge 'dun lhag ma'i rtsang ba rgyun du 'byin pas bdag la dge 'dun kyis smad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/bdag dge slong dge ldan thong ba rgyun tu bgyid pa la rnyismad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pas skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la spu snyol bar bgyid/ 'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la mtshams kyi nang du mchis te/ bzod pa gsol zhing ltung ba rgyun tu bkyid pa de yang spong na / thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du 88—1406

bdag dge slong dge ldan smad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/dge slong dge ldan 'di thong ba rgyun tu bgyid de/ 'di dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba rgyun du bgyis tshopas 'di la dge 'dun gyis gruspo ba dang / gzhi nas spo zub dang / mgu bar bkyi gib dang / gzhi nas mgu bar bgyi ba stsol ba dang 'byin pa mdzad pas lung mnod pa dang / klag pa dang / kha ton bgyi ba dang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bgyi ba dang / nang du sems zhi gnas su bkyi ba shor te/ ltung ba rgyun du bgyid pa ma btang ba 'di la dge 'dun kyis smad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ 'di la smad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pas skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la spu snyol bar bgyid/ 'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la mtshams kyi nang du mchis te/ bzod pa gsol zhing ltung ba rgyun du bkyid pa de'ang spong ngo zhes mchi na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong dge ldan smad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan 5du gsol/ dge slong dge ldan ltung ba rgyun du bgyid pa 'di dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba rgyun du bgyed de/ ltung ba rgyun du bgyid pa ma btang ba 'di la dge 'dun gyis smad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/dge slong dge ldan 'di smad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pas skra 'greng bar gyur/skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la sru snyol bar bgyid/ 'byung bar bskyod/mtshungs par nye bar ston la mtshams kyi nang du mchis te/ bzod pa gsol 88—1407

zhing rtsang ba rgyun du bgyid pa de yang spong ngo zhes mchi na/ de'i slad du dge slong dge ldan smad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la dge 'dun gyis bzod pa mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong dge ldan smad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig/'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong dge ldan smad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab hūṃso 'di gnyis khyim sun 'byin pa sdig pa'i chos kun tu spyod pa lags te/ 'di gnyis khyim sun 'byin par yang bye snang zhing thos la 'tshal/ 'di gnyis sdig pa'i chos kun tu spyod par yang snang zhing thos la 'tshal na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun kyis jeganang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'go mgyogs dang nab so khyim 5sun 'byin pa ma btang ba la bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab 6so 'di gnyis khyim sun 'byin pa sdig pa'i chos kun tu spyod pa lags te/ 'di gnyis khyem sun 'byin par dz+wayang snang zhing thos la 'tshal/ spyig pa'i chos kun tu spyod par yang snang zhing thos la 'tshal te/de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'go mgyogs dang nab 37so khyim sun 'byin pa ma btang ba la bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang 88—1408

dag dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab ①so la bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang — nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab 1so khyem sun 'byin pa ma btang ba la bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag cag dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab yeso khyim sun 'byin pa sdig pa'i chos kun tu spyod pa lags pas bdag cag la dge 'dun gyis bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ bdag cag dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab sgoso bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pas skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing 7/ dge 'dun la spu snyol bar bkyid/ 'byung bar baspyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la / mtshams kyi nang du mchis te bzod pa gsol zhing khyim sun 'byin pa spyig pa'i chos kun tu spyod pa de yang spong na/ thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag cag dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab phyaso bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad du gsol/lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab 9so 'di gnyis khyim sun 'byin pa sdig pa'i chos kun tu spyod pa lags te/ 'di gnyis khyim sun 'byin par snang zhing thos la 'tshal/'di gnyis sdig pa'i chos kun tu spyod par yang snang zhing thos la 'tshal te/khyem sun 'byin pa sdig pa'i chos kun tu spyod pa ma btang ba 'di gnyis la dge 88—1409

'dun gyis bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ 'di gnyis bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pas skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la sru snyol bar bgyid/ 'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la/mtshams kyi nang du mchis te bzod pa gsol zhing khyim sun 'byin pa sdig pa'i chos kun tu spyod pa de yang spong ngo zhes mchi na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun kyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab tshoso bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad thulags pa la dge 'dun kyis bzod pa mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab ri byeso 'di gnyis khyim sun 'byin pa sdig pa'i chos kun tu spyod pas/ 'di gnyis la dge 'dun gyis bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab 4so skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la spu snyol bar bgyid/ 'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la mtshams kyi nang du mchis te bzod pa gsol zhing khyim sun 'byin pa sdig pa'i chos kun tu spyod pa de yang spong ngo zhes mchis pa la bzod pa mdzad na tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab 5so bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shing sne /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab tshuso bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung 88—1410

slong dam pa la slar 'gyed pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad du gsol / lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/dge slong dam pa 'di khyem pa la brnyas thabs bgyid pa rmyede la dge 'dun gyis slar 'gyed 3pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar 'gyed pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pas skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la sru snyel bar bkyid/ 'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la mtshams kyi nang du mchis te/ bzod pa gsol zhing khyim pa la brnyas thabs bgyid pa de yang spong ngo zhes mchi na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge slong dam pa slar 'gyed pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la dge 'dun kyis bzod pa mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong dam pa 'di khyem pa la brnyas thabs bgyid snapas de la dge 'dun gyis slar 'gyed pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong dam pa skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la sru snyol bar bkyid / 'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la/ mtshams kyi nang du mchis te bzod pa gsol zhing khyim pa la brnyas thabs bgyid pa/ de'ang spong ngo zhes mchi ba la bzod pa mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong dam pa slar 'gyed pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun 88—1412

bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'char ka la dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba ltung ba bar ma dang 'dra ba yang bldabs tūte byung la bcabs pa de'i slad du yang gzhi nas bslang ste spo ba stsal lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong 'char ka la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i thong ba byung bas bdag dge slong 'char ka dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis te che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i slad du dge 'dun las zhag drug mgu bar bgyi ba gsol nas/ dge 'dun gyis 2bdag dge slong 'char ka la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i slad du zhag drug mgu bar bgyi ba zustsal te/ bdag mgu bar bgyid bzhin pa las yang dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba thong ba snga ma dang 'dra ba yang byung bas bdag dge slong 'char ka dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis te/ dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba ltung ba snga ma dang 'dra ba yang byung ba de'i slad du dge 'dun las gzhi nas mgu bar bgyi ba gsol nas / dge 'dun gyis bdag dge slong 'char ka la dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba ltung ba snga ma dang 'dra ba yang byung ba de'i slad du gzhi nas mgu bar bgyi ba stsal te bdag gzhi nas mgu bar bgyid bzhin pa las dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba ltung ba bar ma dang 'dra ba yang bldabs te byung nas/ bdag dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba ltung ba bar ma dang 'dra ba yang bldabs sate byung ba de'i be+ed du dge 'dun las yang gzhi nas bslang ste mgu bar bgyi ba gsol na/ thugs 88—1433

'dun gyis dge slong 'char ka la yidage 'dun lhag ma'i thong ba ltung ba bar ma dang 'dra ba yang bldabs snite byung ba de'i slad du yang gzhi nas bslang ste mgu bar bgyi ba gsol to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong 'char ka 'di la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ldung ba byung la dge slong 'char ka 'di dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis te/che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i lcung ba byung ba de'i slad du dge 'dun las zhag drug mgu bar bgyi ba gsol nas/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'char ka 'di la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i slad du zhag drug ༄ —mgu bar bkyi ba sprul te/ 'di mgu bar bgyid bzhin pa las dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba ltung ba snga ma dang 'dra ba yang byung la/ dge slong 'char ka 'di dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis te/ dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba ltung ba snga ma dang 'dra ba yang byung ba de'i be+ed du dge 'dun las gzhi nas mgu bar bkyi ba gsol nas/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'char ka 'di la ④ dge 'dun lhag ma'i thong ba thong ba snga ma dang 'dra ba yang byung ba de'i slad du gzhi nas mgu bar bgyi ba stsal te/ 'di gzhi nas mgu bar bgyid bzhin pa las dge 'dun lhag ma'i thong ba ltung ba bar ma dang 'dra ba yang bldabs lhate byung la dge slong 'char ka 'di dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis te/ dge 'dun lhag ma'i thong ba ltung ba bar ma dang 'dra ba yang bldabs 6te byung ba de'i slad du dge 'dun las yang gzhi nas bslang ste mgu bar bgyi ba gsol na/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'char ka la dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba ltung ba bar ma dang 'dra ba yang bldabs tsa te byung ba de'i slad du yang gzhi nas bslang ste mgu 88—1435
