slong 'char ka 'di la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba tshol dge slong 'char ka 'di dge 'dun kyi gan du mchis te/ che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i be+ed du dge 'dun las zhag drug mgu bar bgyi ba gsol nas/ dge 'dun gyis khyedage slong 'char ka 'di la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i thong ba byung ba de'i slad du zhag drug mgu bar bgyi ba stsal te/ dge slong 'char ka 'dis che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i slad du zhag drug mgu bar bgyis lags te dge 'dun las dbyung ba gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'char ka la ༄ che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i thong ba byung ba de'i slad du zhag drug mgu bar bgyis pa dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /'char ka khyod nyon cig /khyod kyis legs par ma byas so/ /legs pa shin tu ma byas so/ /bya ba ma yin pa d+nghagazhan byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de'i chos ni 'di ltar 'dod chags de dang bral bar bgyi ba'i phyir sems rnam par grol ba dang shes rab rnam par grol ba'i chos ston zhing / zhe sdang 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba dang / gti mug 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir sems rnam par grol ba dang shes rab rnam par grol ba'i chos ston bzhin du khyod kyis mi mdzes pa 'di lta bu 'di byas pa mi rigs so/ /mi gti mug can khyod kyis sbrul nag po dug myur du khyab par byed pa dug drag po dug rno ba la lag pa gnyi gas bzung ba ni bla'i kun tu chags pa'i sems kyis rang gi yan lag gi rnam pa la gzung byub ni 88—1437

de lta ma yin no/ /mi gti mug can khyod lag pa gang dag gis bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams las dad pas sbyin pa blang bar bya ba'i lag pa de dag nyid kyis mi mdzes pa 'di lta bu 'di bya ba mi rigs so/ /mi gti mug can khrod kyis de ltar bdag la bsnyen bkur bya ba nyams su blangs par 1gyur to/ /'char ka gnyis po 'di dag ni chos kyi sgron ma dang / chos kyi snang ba dang /chos kyi 'od dang / chos kyi gsal ba dang / chos kyi snang ba gsal ba dang /chos kyi mar me dang / chos kyi rab gsal med par byed pa ste/ gnyis gang zhe na/ ltung ba 'byin pa gang yin pa dang / ltung ba byung nas chos bzhin du phyir mi 'chos pa gang yin pa'o/ /gnyis ni sdig pa'i rtsa ba mi rko3sna/ rgyun las bzlog pa la mi 'bad/ 'bab chu dang 'khri shing mi skems/ bdud mi 'dul/bdud kyi rgyal mtshan mi snyol/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan mi sgreng / spyig pa'i rgyun mi gcod / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo chos dang mthun par bskor ba'i rjes su mi bskor ba ste/gnyis gang zhe na/ ltung ba 'byin pa gang yin pa dang / ltung ba byung nas chos bzhin du phyir mi 'chos pa gang yin pa'o/ /gnyis ni kun nas nyon mongs par 'gyur ba dang gnyis kyi zag pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba ste/ gnyis gang zhe na/ltung ba 'byin pa gang yin pa dang / ltung ba byung nas chos bzhin du phyir mi 'chos pa gang yin pa'o/ /'char ka khyod kyis ltung ba 'di ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na mi rtag pa'i 'du shes dang / mi rtag pa la sdug bsngal ba'i 'du shes dang / sdug bsngal ba la bdag med pa'i 'du shes dang / zas la mi mthun pa'i 'du shes dang / 'jig rten thams cad la mngon par mi dga' 88—sde438

ba'i 'du shes dang / nyes dmigs kyi 'du shes dang spong ba'i 'du shes dang /'dod chags dang bral ba'i 'du shes dang / 'gog pa'i 'du shes dang /'chi ba'i 'du shes dang / mi sdug pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par bsngos pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par rnags pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par bam pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par 'bus gzhigs pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par zos pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par dmar ba'i 'du shes dang / rnam par 'thor ba'i 'du shes dang / rus gong gi 'du shes dang / stong pa nyid du so sor rtog pa'i 'du shes kyi 'os ma yin no4/ /bsam gtan dang po dang /gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang / ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid kyi 'bras bu dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi yul dang / lha'i rna ba dang / sems kyi rnam grangs dang / sngon gyi gnas dang / 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba dang / zag pa zad pa'i 'os ma yin no/ /'char ka khyod 2ltung ba 'di ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na/ 'gro ba gnyis las gang yang rung ba zhig khyod kyis — 'gro ba yin par shes par bya ste/sems can dmyal ba'am dud 'gro'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang las kyi mtha' 'chab pa'i 'gro ba ni gnyis te sems can dmyal ba'am dud 'gro'o/ /gang dag ngas bshad pa la yid mi ches pa de dag ni bcabs par sems so zhes 88—1439

gsungs so/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong 'char ka 'di la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung la/ dge slong 'char ka 'di dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis te che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i slad du dge 'dun las zhag drug mgu bar bgyi ba gsol nas dge 'dun kyis dge slong 'char ka 'di la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i slad du zhag drug mgu bar bgyi ba sprul te/ dge slong 'char ka 'dis che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i slad du zhag drug mgu bar bgyis lags te dge 'dun las dbyung ba gsol na/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'char ka che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i slad du zhag drug mgu bar bgyis pa dbyung ba mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong 'char ka che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i slad du zhag drug mgu bar bgyes pa dbyung bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'char ka la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i slad du zhag drug mgu bar bgyi ba dbyung lags te/'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /'char ka rjod nyon cig/'char ka khyod kyis legs par 1byas so/ /legs pa shin tu yang —byas so/ /gnyis ni mkhas pa/ gnyis ni gsal ba/ gnyis ni dge ba/ gnyis ni skyes bu dam pa ste/ gnyis gang zhe na/ ltung ba mi 'byin pa gang yin pa dang /88—1440

ltung ba byung nas chos bzhin du phyir ①'chos pa gang yin pa'o/ /gnyis ni sdig pa'i rtsa ba rko zhub/ rgyun las bzlog pa la 'bad pa/ 'bab chu dang 'khri shing skems pa/ bdud 'dul ba/ bdud kyi rgyal mtshan snyol ba/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba/ sdog pa'i rgyun gcod rngo pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo chos dang mthun par ④bskor ba'i rjes su bskor ba ste/ gnyis gang zhe na/ ltung ba mi 'byin pa gang yin pa dang / ltung ba byung nas chos bzhin du phyir 'chos pa ④gang yin pa'o/ /gnyis ni rnam par byang bar 'gyur zhing kun nas nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ba dang / gnyis kyi zag pa 'phel bar mi 'gyur te/ gnyis gang zhe na/ ltung ba mi 'byin pa gang yin pa dang / thong ba byung nas chos bzhin du phyir 'chos pa gang yin pa'o/ /'char ka khyod ltung ba 'di bshags shing so sor bshags pas mi rtag pa'i 'du shes dang / mi rtag pa la snyug bsngal ba'i 'du shes dang / snyug bsngal ba la bdag med pa'i 'du shes dang / zas la mi mthun pa'i 'du shes dang / 'jig rten thams cad la mngon par mi dga' ba'i 'du shes dang / nyes dmigs kyi 'du shes dang / spong ba'i 'du shes dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i 'du shes dang / 'gog pa'i 'du shes dang / 'chi ba'i 'du shes dang / mi sdug pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par bsngos pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par rnags pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par bam pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par 'bus gzhigs pa'i 'du shes dang /rnam par zos pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par dmar ba'i 'du shes dang /rnam par 'thor ba'i 'du shes dang / rus gong gi 'du shes dang / stong pa nyid 88—1441

du so sor rtog dzopa'i 'du shes kyi 'os su gyur pa yin/ bsam gtan dang po dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / byams pa dang /snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang //snye ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched dang / rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid kyi 'bras bu dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi yul dang / lha'i rna ba dang / sems kyi rnam grangs dang / sngon gyi gnas dang / 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba dang / zag pa zad pa'i 'os su byung ba yin pa'o/ /'char ka ltung ba 'di bshags shing so sor bshags pas 'gro ba gnyis po las gang yang rung ba zhig khyod kyis 7'gro ba yin par shes par bya ste/ lha'am mi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang las kyi mtha' mi 'chab 3 pa'i 'gro ba ni gnyis te/ lha'am mi'o/ /gang dag ngas bshad pa la yid ches pa de dag gis thu'achab par mi sems so ④zhes gsungs so/ /yang gsungs paX /bcabs pas 9 char pa bzhin du 'bab/ /bshags pa char bzhin 'bab mi 'gyur / /de lta bas na bshags par bya/ /de ltar ⑩char bzhin de mi 'bab/ /ce'o / /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka khyod byung zin gyis bag yod par sgrubs (nyushig/phyir bcos pa'i gzhi'o// //12bam po dgu pa ste tha ma/ phyir bcos pa'i gzhi dang nye ba'i gzhi'i sdom la / 'dre dang phyag bya ma yin dang / /bslab pa sbyin pa tha ma'o/ /dge 88—1442

'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa gre 2skyes 'di dge slong ma rnams dang lhan k+ṣebyug 'dre zhing gnas na/ gal te dge 'dun kyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis ༄ gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong gre skyes dge slong ma rnams dang lhan cig 'dre zhing gnas pa la gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong gre 5skyes 'di dge slong ma rnams dang lhan 6cig 'dre zhing gnas te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong gre skyes dge slong ma rnams 7dang lhan cig 'dre zhing gnas pa la/ de gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad na tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong gre hūṃ skyes dge slong ma rnams tsodang lhan cig 'dre zhing gnas pa la gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong gre skyes dge slong ma rnams 1 dang lhan cig 'dre zhing gnas pa la gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun 'phags ma rnams bdag la gsan du gsol/ 'phags pa dge slong gre skyes dge slong ma rnams dang lhan cig 'dre zhing gnas pas — dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun 'phags ma rnams kyis 'phags pa dge slong gre skyes gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la phyag bgyi ba'i 'os ma lags pa'i sdom pa stsol na/ gal te dge 88—1443

'dun 'phags ma rnams kyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun 'phags ma rnams kyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun 'phags ma rnams kyis 'phags pa dge slong gre skyes gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la phyag bgyi ba'i 'os ma lags pa'i sdom pa sprul sna༄to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun 'phags ma 3rnams gsan du gsol/ 'phags pa du dge slong gre skyes dge slong ma rnams dang lhan cig 'dre zhing gnas pas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun 'phags ma rnams kyis 'phags pa dge slong gre skyes dge 'dun gyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la phyag bgyi ba'i 'os ma lags pa'i sdom pa gsol na/ 'phags ma gang dag 'phags pa dge slong gre skyes dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la phyag bgyi ba'i 'os ma lags pa'i sdom pa stsal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun 'phags ma rnams kyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun 'phags ma rnams kyis 'phags pa gre skyes dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la phyag bgyi ba'i 'os ma 4lags pa'i sdom pa srul lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol / lits+tsha bī yechen pos tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor la yang dag pa ma lags pas skur na gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis 'di lits+tsha bī 7chen po la lhung bzed khas 7dbub pa kyibagye'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun 88byed1444

btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag lits+tsha bī dze+echen po mi dge ba'i gogs pos bslus pas 'phags pa gyad bu nor la yang dag pa ma lags pas sgur pas dge 'dun gyis bdag la lhung bzed khas dbub pa mdzad dege/ bdag lhung bzed khas phub pa dge 'dun las lhung bzed slar bzlog par gsol na/thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du thong bzed slar bzlog tu gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ lits+tsha bī byechen po mi dge ba'i grogs pos bslus pa 'di / tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor la yang dag pa ma lags pas sgur te/dge 'dun gyis de la lhung bzed khas dbub pa mdzad lags /④pa las/ lits+tsha bī chen pos phyaldung bzed khas phub pa de'i stsodage 'dun las lhang bzed slar bzlog pa gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi kludus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis lits+tsha bī snyechen po las tsolhung bzed slar bzlog pa mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong dga' byed kyis bslab pa ma phul bar mi tshangs par spyod pa 'khrig pa'i chos bsten kyang bcab pa'i sems gcig tsam gyis kyang bcabs tso par ma bgyis te/ bdag dge slong dga' byed dge 'dun la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bslab pa gsol na/ thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag dge slong dga' byed la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bslab pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong dga' byed 'dis bslab pa ma phul bar mi tshangs par spyod pa'i skye'akhrig pa'i chos bsten kyang bcab pa'i 1sems gcig 88byed1445

tsam gyis kyang bcabs nyupar ma bgyis te/ dge slong dga' byed 'di dge 'dun las ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bslab pa gsol na— sna/ gal te dge 'dun gyi rngudus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun kyis dge slong dga' byed la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bslab pa sprul to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong dga' byed 'dis babe+eb pa ma phul bar mi tshangs par spyod pa thu'akhrig pa'i chos bsten kyang bcab pa'i sems gcig tsam gyis kyang bcabs 3par ma bgyis pas dge slong dga' byed 'di dge 'dun las ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bslab pa gsol te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong dga' byed la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bslab pa stsol na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong dga' byed la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bslab pa stsal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste / de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong dga' byed la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bslabs ‘ pa stsal lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /phyir bcos pa'i gzhi dang nye ba'i gzhi'o// //sa gzhan na gnas pa'i spyod pa dang yongs su spyod pa'i gzhi'i sdom la/ngo bo nyid brjod gtod dang len/ /gso spyong dang ni dgag dbye'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka 'di dge bsnyen ma yid ches pa'i tshig dang ldan pa'i tshig gis 'go ba yang mchid kyis mi 88—1446

'tshal / 'greng ba yang mchid kyis 1mi 'tshal/ 'dug pa yang mchid kyis phyami 'tshal/ nyal ba yang mchid kyis 5mi 'tshal/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la dge bsnyen ma yid ches pa'i tshig dang ldan pa'i ④tshig gis de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug pa 5stsol to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o / /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka 'di dge bsnyen ma yid ches pa'i tshig dang ldan pa'i tshig gis 'gro ba yang mchid kyis mi 'tshal/ 'greng ba yang mchid kyis mi 'tshal/ 'dug pa yang mchid kyis mi 'tshal/tre nyal ba yang mchid kyis mi 'tshal te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la tso dge bsnyen ma yid ches pa'i tshig dang ldan pa'i tshig gis de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug pa stsol na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la dge bsnyen ma yid ches pa'i tshig dang ldan pa'i tshig gis de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par sprul bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung 8shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka dge bsnyen ma yid ches pa'i tshig dang ldan pa'i tshig gis 'gro ba yang mchid kyis mi 'tshal/ 'greng ba yang mchid kyis mi 'tshal/ 'dug pa yang mchid kyis mi 'tshal/9 nyal ba yang mchid kyis mi 'tshal ba la de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par nyu stsal lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong 88—1447

'char ka de'i hūṃngo bo nyid — tshol du sprul ba/ skra 'greng bar gyur skra 'phyar bar gyur pa'i shudage 'dun la spu snyol bar bgyid/ 'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston 3la mtshams kyi phyanang du mchis te bzod pa gsol zhing gzhi gang las sma dbab pa'i phrin las mdzad pa'i gzhi de skulas slar ldog na thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag dge slong 'char ka de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du stsal ba la bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan 3du gsol/ dge slong 'char ka de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du stsal ba'i 3 skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la spu snyol bar bgyid/ 'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la mtshams kyi nang du mchis te bzod pa gsol zhing / gzhi gang las sma dbab pa'i phrin las mdzad pa'i gzhi de be+er ldog na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang /dge 'dun gyes tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du stsal ba la bzod pa mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ / dge slong 'char ka de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du sprul ba 'di skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la spu snyol bar bgyid/'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la mtshams kyi nang du mchis te bzod pa gsol zhing / gzhi gang las sma dbab pa'i phrin las mdzad pa'i gzhi de las slar ldog ste/ de'i slad du dge slong 'char ka de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du sprul ba la bzod pa mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong 'char ka de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du stsal ba la bzod pa mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma 88—1448

gsung nyushig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis 3dge slong 'char ka de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du 6) ba la bzod pa mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i thong ba byung la zla ba phyed bcabs pas/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung la zla ba phyed bcabs pa de'i slad du dge 'dun las zla ba phyed spo ba gsol te/ dge 'dun gyis bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba la zla ba phyed bcabs pa de'i slad du zla ba phyed spo ba stsal bas zhag 'di snyed cig ni bgyis lags/ bgyi ba ni zhag 'di snyed cig mchis te / dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis bdag spo ba bgyid par gzung du gsol/lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i thong ba byung la/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i slad du dge 'dun las zhag drug mgu bar bgyi ba gsol te/ dge 'dun kyis bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la che ge mo las byung ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung ba de'i slad du zhag drug mgu bar bkyi ba stsal bas zhag 'di snyed cig ni bgyis lags/ bgyi ba ni zhag 'di snyed cig mchis lags 4te/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis 88—1449

bdag mgu bar bgyi ba spyod par gzung du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba spo ba bgyid pas dge slong 'thab krol bkyid pa/ mtshang 'bru bar 1bgyid pa/ 'thab mo bgyid pa/ 'gyed par bgyid pa/ rtsod par bgyid pa dag mchis zhes thos te/ de dag gis bdag la gzhi ༄ —'dis gleng bar 'gyur/dran par bgyid par 'gyur bas bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag gi mdun du spo ba slar gtang 4bar bgyi'o/ /phyir rgol ba mi mdza' ba de dag slar mchi nas yang spo ba blang bar bgyi'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis bdag rang bzhin du gnas par gzung du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag dge slong spo ba bgyid pa'i dgra bo dge slong mchis te/bdag dge slong 5ming 'di zhes bgyi ba spo ba spyod pa bag yangs su bgyid cing slar yang len par bgyid do/ /yang blangs te spyod par bgyid na tshe dang ldan pa 6bdag ngo tsha ba 7ma mchis par mi gzung du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mgu bar bgyid pas/ dge slong 'thab krol bgyid pa/ mtshang 'bru bar bgyid pa/ 'thab mo bgyid pa/ 'gyed par bgyid pa9/ rtsod par bgyid pa dag mchis zhes thos te/ de dag gis bdag la gzhi 'dis gleng bar 'gyur/ dran par bgyid par 'gyur bas bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag gi mdun du mgu bar bgyi ba slar gtang bar 7bgyi'o/ /phyir rgol ba mi mdza' ba de dag slar mchis na yang mgu bar bgyi ba ( sgyublang bar bgyi'o / /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis bdag rang bzhin du gnas par 88—1450

gzung du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/bdag dge slong mgu bar bgyi ba'i dgra bo dge slong mchis te/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mgu ba'i spyod pa bag yangs su bkyid cing slar yang len par bgyid do/ /yang blangs te spyod par bgyid na tshe dang ldan pas bdag ngo tsha ba ma mchis par mi gzung du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bkyi ba spo ba bgyid pas dge slong 'thab krol bgyid pa/mtshang 'bru bar bgyid pa/ 'thab nye mo bgyid pa/ 'gyed par bgyid pa/ rtsod byupar bgyid pa dag mchi zhes thos te/ de dag gis bdag la gzhi 'dis gleng bar 'gyur/ dran par bgyid par 'gyur bas bdag gis de skad thos na dge slong rnams kyi mdun du spo ba slar gtang 1ba phyir rgol ba mi mdza' ba de dag slar mchis lags pas bdag spo ba yang slar len to/ /spo ba zhag ma ce'akhor ba rnams bgyi'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis bdag spo ba bgyid par gzung du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgye ba spo ba bgyid pa'i dgra bo dge slong mchis te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas spo ba'i spyod pa bag yangs su bkyis pa dgra bo dge slong de dag slar mchis lags pas bdag spo ba yang slar len to/ /spo ba zhag ma zhe'akhor ba rnams bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pas bdag spo ba bgyid par gzung du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ thabs yin no / /legs so/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mgu bar bgyid pas dge slong 'thab krol bgyid 88—1451

pa / mtshang tu'abru bar bgyid pa/ 'thab zhu mo bgyid pa/ 'gyed par bgyid pa/ rtsod par bgyid pa dag mchi zhes thos te/ de dag gis bdag la gzhi 'dis gleng bar 'gyur/ dran par bgyid par 'gyur bas/ bdag gis de skad thos nas dge slong rnams kyi 5mdun du mgu bar bgyi ba slar btang ba phyir rgol ba mi mdza' ba de dag slar mchis lags pas bdag mgu bar bgyi ba yang slar len to/ /mgu bar bgyi ba zhag ma 'khor ba rnams bgyi'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis bdag mgu bar bgyid par gzung du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mgu ba bgyi ba'i dgra bo dge slong mchis te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas mgu ba'i spyod pa bag yangs su bkyis pa dgra bo dge slong de dag slar mchis lags pas bdag mgu bar bkyi ba yang slar len to/ /mgu bar bgyi ba zhag ma 'khor 5ba rnams bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pas bdag mgu bar bgyid pār gzung du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /sa gzhan na gnas pa'i spyod pa'i gzhi'o// //dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di ni 6glengs shing dran par bgyis kyang skabs 'byed du mi btub ste/'di dge slong rnams kyis smra bar mi bgyi ba 7nyid du rnam par gzhag cing mi gdams par bgyis kyang skabs mi 'byed na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gso sbyong gzhag par bgyi'o/ /'di ni 88—1 52

gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di glengs shing dran par bgyis kyang skabs 'byed du mi btub ste / 'di dge slong rnams kyis smra bar mi bgye ba nyid du rnam par gzhag cing mi gdams par bgyis kyang skabs mi 'byed de/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gso spyong gzhag par bgyi na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gso spyong gzhag par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gso spyong gzhag lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di glengs shing dran par bgyes kyang skabs 'byed du mi btub ste / 'di dge slong rnams kyis smra bar mi bgyi ba nyid du rnam par gzhag cing mi nyugadams par bgyis kyang skabs mi 'byed na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi rngudus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dgag dbye gzhag par bgyi'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgye ba 'di glengs shing dran par bgyis kyang skabs 'byed du mi btub ste/ 'di dge slong rnams kyis smra bar mi 'gyur ba nyid du rnam par gzhag cing mi gnas /par bgyis kyang skabs mi 'byed do/ /de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgye ba'i dgag dbye gzhag par bgyi na/ tshe dang 88—1453

ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dgag dbye gzhag par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dgag dbye gzhag lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /yongs su sbyang ba'i gzhi'o// //las bye ba dang / dge 'dun bye ba'i gzhi'i sdom la/ bzod pa gsol dang mthun pa dang / /gso spyong gsol ba len 'jug pa'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag kau shāsdi pa'i dge slong nang par snga zhig tu mdo sde dang 'dul ba dang ma mo'i lung la rnam par rtog rtog na 'di snyam du hūṃbagyid de/ gang las bdag cag las 'thab pa dang / mtshang 3'bru ba dang /rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa byung ba'i gzhi ni 'di lta ste/ ltung ba byung ngam ma byung ba dang / gnas nas phyung ngam ma phyung ba lags na/ bdag cag la ltung ba byung gi ltung ba ma byung ba ma lags/ gnas nas phyung ba lags kyi gnas nas ma phyung 5ba ma lags te/ gang gnas nas phyung ba ni chos dang mthun pa'i phrin las ma 'khrugs par dzigazhag par mi 'os pa 3bkyis so snyam bgyis nas/ bdag grong khyer yangs pa can kyi 8dge slong dang sdums bgyi zhing mthun par bgyi'o snyam ste/ bdag kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong skra 'greng bar gyur/skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la sru snyol bar bgyid na/sna/ 'byung bar bskyod pa 1 mtshungs par nye bar ston la mtshams kyi nang du mchis te bzod pa 88—1454

gsol zhing gzhi gang las gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad pa'i gzhi de las slar ldog par bgyid na/ thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ kau shām+bhi pa'i dge slong hūṃganas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'di skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la ༄dz+waspu snyol bar bgyid/ 'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la/rngo mtshams kyi nang du mchis te bzod pa gsol zhing gzhi gang las gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad pa'i gzhi de las slar ldog par bgyid na/gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis kau shāsdi pa'i dge slong gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad pa'i gzhi de dag las slar ldog par bgyid/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag kau shāsdi pa'i 4dge slong gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa 5rnams gsan du gsol/ kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'di 6skra 'greng bar gyur/ skra 'phyar bar gyur cing dge 'dun la sru snyol bar bgyid/'byung bar bskyod/ mtshungs par nye bar ston la/ mtshams kyi nang du mchis te bzod pa gsol zhing gzhi gang las geganas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang 88—1455

dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pa la bzod pa mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/bdag kau shāsbyi pa'i dge slong la dge 'dun gyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pas bdag dge 'dun gyi nang 1du mchis te bzod pa gsol nas dge 'dun gyis bdag la bzod pa mdzad lags te/ bdag kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'khor dang bcas pa mthun pa gsol na/ thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'khor dang bcas pa la mthun pa sprul du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ kau shāsdi pa'i dge slong 'di la dge 'dun gyis 7gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pas 'di dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis te bzod pa gsol nas/ dge 'dun gyis 'di la bzod pa mdzad lags te/ kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'khor dang bcas pa 'di mthun pa gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi — dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'khor dang bcas pa 'di la mthun pa stsol to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ kau shāsbyi pa'i dge slong 'di la dge 'dun gyis gnas 88—1436

nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pas 'di dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis te bzod pa gsol nas/ dge 'dun gyis 'di la bzod pa mdzad lags te/kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'khor dang bcas pa 'di nyumathun pa gsol te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'khor dang bcas pa 'di la mthun pa spyod na—/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'khor dang bcas pa 'di la mthun pa byed bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'khor dang bcas pa la mthun pa byed lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag kau shāsbyi pa'i dge slong la dge 'dun kyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pas bdag dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis te bzod pa gsol nas/ dge 'dun gyis bdag la bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ bdag bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'khor dang bcas pa dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis nas namathun pa gsol te/dge 'dun gyis bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la mthun pa byed lags pas/ bdag kau shāsbyi pa'i dge slong 'khor dang bcas pa mthun pa stsal ba la ༄ mthun pa'i gso spyong gsol na/ thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag kau shāsdi pa'i dge slong 'khor dang bcas pa la ④88—1457

mthun pa stsal ba la mthun pa'i gso sbyong stsal du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ kau shāsbyi pa'i dge slong 'di la dge 'dun gyis —1gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pas/ 'di dge 'dun gyi segan du mchis te bzod pa gsol nas/ dge 'dun gyis 'di la bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'khor dang bcas pa 'di/ dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis nas mthun pa gsol te/dge 'dun gyes kau shām+bhi pa'i dge slong 'khor dang bcas pa 'di la mthun pa sprul lags pas/ kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong 'khor dang bcas pa mthun pa sprul — —ba 'di mthun pa'i gso spyong gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ④dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis kau shāsbyi pa'i dge slong 'khor dang bcas pa mthun pa sprul ba la mthun pa'i gso sbyong stsol to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/kau shāshrī pa'i dge slong 'di la dge 'dun kyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i phrin las mdzad lags pas 'di dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis te/ bzod pa gsol nas/dke 'dun kyis 'di la bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags te/ bzod pa'i phrin las mdzad lags pa 'khor dang bcas nga/ 'di dge 'dun gyi gan du mchis nas mthun pa gsol te/ dge 'dun gyis kau shāsbyi pa'i dge slong 'khor dang bcas pa 'di la mthun pa stsal 5lags pas/ kau shāsbyi pa'i dge slong 'khor dang bcas pa mthun pa stsal ba 'di mthun pa'i gso spyong gsol te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis kau shāsdi pa'i dge slong 'khor dang bcas pa mthun pa sprul ba la ⑥mthun pa'i gso sbyong gsol na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag kau shāsbyi pa'i dge slong 'khor dang 88—1458

bcas pa mthun pa stsal ba la mthun pa'i gso spyong stsal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/kyesna dge 'dun gyis kau shāsbyi pa'i dge slong 'khor dang bcas pa la 3mthun pa stsal ba la mthun pa'i gso spyong stsal lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /las bye ba'i gzhi'o// //tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge sbyong go ta ma ni sha za ste/ bdag cag gis sha bza' bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhi de las srog chags gsod par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dge spyong go ta ma ni 'o ma 'thungs tezu/ bdag cag gis btung bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhi de las be'u la gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /dge sbyong go ta ma ni lan tshwa za ste/ bdag cag gis bza' bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ khu ba las gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /dge sbyong go ta ma ni gos dras pa kyon te/ bdag cag gis bsgo bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhi de las dad pas sbyin par bya ba chud 4zos par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dge spyong go ta ma ni dgon pa na gnas par byed de/ bdag cag ni cegrong du gnas par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhi de las dad pas sbyin par bya ba yongs su ma spyad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed cag las gang brtul zhugs kyi gnas lnga po 'di dag gis dag pa dang grol ba dang / nges par 'byung bar 'dod pa dang / bzod pa dang / legs par 'dzin pa des dge sbyong go ta ma las ring du gyis shig /so sor gyis shig /88—1459

tha dad du kyis shig /rgyang srings nyushig /thag srings thushig /logs shig tu 'dug cig /tshe dang ldan pa dag dge sbyong go ta ma ni sha za ste/ bdag cag gis sha za rngo bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhi de las srog chags gsod par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dge sbyong go ta ma ni 'o ma 'thungs te④/bdag cag gis btung bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhi de las be+e'u la gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /dge sbyong go thuta ma ni lan tshwa za ste/ bdag cag ⑥gis bza' bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ khu ba las gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /dge sbyong go ta ma ni gos dras pa gyon te/ bdag cag gis bgo bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhi de las dad pas sbyin par bya ba chud phyozos par du'agyur ba'i phyir ro//dge spyong gau ta ma ni dgon pa na gnas par byed de/ bdag cag ni grong du gnas par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhi de las dad pas sbyin par bya ba yongs su ma spyad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang shedag khyed cag las gang brtul zhugs kyi gnas lnga po 'di dag gis dag pa dang / grol ba dang /nges par 'byung bar 'dod pa dang / bzod pa dang / legs par 'dzin pa des tshul shing long shig /'khor lo bye ba'i gzhi'o// //rtsod pa'i gzhi'i sdom la/ gzu dang gsal dang sbed pa dang / /dge 'dun bsnyen sbyigasum gnas brtan dang / /'drim dang dran dang ma smyos dang / /khyed dang de dag bdag 'dun bshags/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod dge 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba byung ba rnams mngon sum kyis 'dul bas rnam par zhi bar byed par spro'am/ spro'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gzu bo 88byed/460

ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba byung ba rnams mngon sum kyis 'dul bas rnam par zhi bar bgyid par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis gzu bo ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di rtsod pa rnam par zhi bar bkyid par bsko bar bgyi ste/ gzu bo ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'dis hūṃdage 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba byung ba rnams mngon gsum ༄1gyis 'dul bas rtsod pa rnam par zhi bar bkyid do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol / gzu bo ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba byebyung ba rnams rnam par zhi bar bgyid par spro ste/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di rtsod pa rnam par zhi bar bgyid par bsko ④na/tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gzu bo ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rtsod pa rnam par zhi bar bgyid par bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis gzu bo ming 'di zhes bkyi ba 'di rtsod pa rnam par zhi bar bgyid par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar phyacang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod dge 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba rnam par zhi bar byed par spro'am / spro'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong gsal ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba rnam par zhi bar bgyid par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di gsal bar bskos te4/ gsal ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 88—1461

'dun la rtsod pa byung ba rnam par zhi bar byed do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gsal ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba rnam par zhi bar bgyid par spro ste/ de'i slad du dge 'dun kyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di rtsod pa rnam par zhi bar bgyid par bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gsal ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di rtsod pa rnam par zhi bar bkyid par bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod byung gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis gsal ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di rtsod pa rnam par zhi bar bgyid par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khrod dge 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba rnam par zhi bar byed par spro'am/ spro'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong gsal ba'i yang gsal ba tshoming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba rnam par zhi bar bgyid par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi 2dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di gsal ba'i yang gsal bar bsko bar bgyi ste/ gsal ba'i yang gsal ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba rnam par zhi bar bgyid do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gsal ba'i yang gsal ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la rtsod 1pa byung ba rnam par zhi bar bgyid par spyo ste/ de'i slad du dge 'dun kyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di rtsod pa rnam par zhi bar bkyid par bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gsal ba'i yang gsal ba 88—1462

ming 'di zhes bkyi ba rtsod pa rnam par zhi bar bgyid par bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis gsal ba'i yang gsal ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di rtsod pa rnam par zhi bar bgyid par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa sbed par spro'am/ spro'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bya tshob 'di dge 'dun gyi k+ṣertsod pa sbed par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di rtsod pa sbed par bsko bar bgye ste/ rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bya ba 'di dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa sbed do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa sbed par spro ste/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di rtsod pa sbed par bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di rtsod pa sted par bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgye ba 'di rtsod pa sbed par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to / /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ rtsod pa 'di gnas che 1ge mo zhes bgyi bar gang zag che ge mo zhes bgyi ba dang / mang thuge mo zhes bgyi ba las gzhi 'di'i slad du byung nas yun 'di srid cig lags te/ rtsod pa 'di 88byed1463

gzu bo rnams la phul na gzu bo rnams kyis kyang rnam par zhi bar bkyid rngo ma thog ste/ de dag gis dge 'dun la phul nas dge 'dun gyis kyang rnam par zhi bar bgyid rngo ma thog ste/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong gsal ba dag bskos na/dge slong gsal ba rnams kyis kyang rnam par zhi bar bgyid rngo ma thog ste/ de dag gis dge slong gsal ba'i yang gsal ba dag bskos na dge slong gsal ba'i yang gsal ba 1de dag gis kyang rnam par zhi bar bgyid rngo ma thog ste/ de dag gis gsal ba rnams la phul ba las/ gsal ba rnams kyis dge 'dun la phul nas dge 'dun gyis bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rtsod pa sbed par bskos te/ bdag rtsod pa sbed pa dge slong ming 'di zhes bkyi bas rtsod pa 'di/gnas brtan dang bcas/ so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun la dbul lo / /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis rtsod pa 'di zla ba gsum gyi mtha'i thu tshun chad kyis rnam par zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin pa dag gsan du gsol/rtsod pa 'di gnas che ge mo zhes bgyi bar/ gang zag ga ge mo dang / mang 3 ge mo zhes bgyi ba las gzhi 'di'i slad du rtsod pa 4byung nas yun 'di srid gcig 5lags te/ rtsod pa 'di gzu bo rnams la phul na/ gzu bo rnams kyis kyang rnam par zhi bar bgyid rngo ma thog ste/ de dag gis dge 'dun la phul na dge 'dun gyis kyang rnam par zhi bar bgyid rngo ma thog ste/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong gsal ba dag bskos na/ dge slong gsal ba rnams kyis kyang rnam par zhi bar bgyid rngo ma thog ste/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong gsal 5ba'i yang gsal ba dag bskos na dge slong gsal ba'i yang gsal ba de dag gis rnam par zhi bar 88—1464

bgyid rngo ma thog ste/ de dag gis gsal ba rnams la phul ba las gsal ba rnams kyis dge 'dun la phul nas dge 'dun gyis bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rtsod pa sbed par bskos te/ bdag rtsod pa sbed pa dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas rtsod pa 'di/ gnas brtan dang bcas/ so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun la zla ba gsum gyi mtha' tshun chad du phul na/gnas brtan dang bcas/ so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun gyis kyang rnam par zhi bar bkyid rngo ma thog ste/ des kyang bdag rtsod pa sbed pa dge slong hūṃbheming 'di zhes bgye ba la sprul nas/ bdag rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas rtsod pa 'di/ mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang /ma mo 'dzin pa rnams thul dbul lo/ /mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin pa rnams kyis rtsod pa 'di zla ba drug gi mtha' tshun chad kyis rnam par zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gnas brtan gsan ༄ du gsol / rtsod pa 'di gnas che ge mo zhes bgyi bar/ gang zag ga ge mo zhes bkyi ba dang / mang —ge mo zhes bgyi ba las gzhi 'di'i slad du byung nas yun 'di srid cig lags te/ rtsod pa 'di gzu bo snyernams la phul na gzu bo rnams kyis kyang rnam par zhi bar bgyid 6rngo ma thog ste/ de dag gis dge 'dun la phul nas dge 'dun gyis kyang rnam par zhi bar bgyid rngo ma thog ste/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong gsal ba dag bskos na/ dge slong gsal ba rnams kyis kyang rnam par zhi bar bgyid rngo ma thog ste/ de dag gis dge slong gsal ba'i yang gsal ba mubaskos na/ dge slong gsal ba'i yang gsal ba de dag gis kyang rnam par zhi bar bgyid rngo ma thog ste/ de dag gis gsal ba rnams la phul 88—1465

ba las/ gsal ba rnams kyis dge 'dun la phul nas/ dge 'dun gyis bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rtsod pa sbed par bskos te/ bdag rtsod pa sbed pa dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas rtsod pa 'di/ gnas brtan ky-isnadang bcas / so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun la zla ba gsum gyi mtha' tshun chad du phul na/ des kyang rnam par zhi bar bgyid rngo ma thog ste/ des bdag rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la sprul nas/ bdag rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas rtsod pa 'di/ mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin pa rnams la zla ba drug gi 2mtha' tshun chad du phul na de dag gis kyang rnam par zhi bar bgyed bye rngo ma thog ④nas/ de dag gis bdag rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la 5stsal te/ bdag rtsod pa sbed pa dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas rtsod pa 'di gnas brtan la 'bul gyelo/ /gnas brtan gyis rtsod pa 'di thug pa ma mchis pa tshun chad kyis rnam par zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod dge 'dun la tshul shing 'brim par spro'am / spro'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la tshul shing 'brim par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun kyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyes dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mutshul shing 'brim par bsko bar bgyi ste/ dge slong tshul shing 'brim pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba tshul shing 'brim mo/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol / dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la tshul shing 'brim par spro ste/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong reming 'di zhes bkyi ba 'di 88—1466

tshul shing 'brim par bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di tshul shing 'brim par bsko bar mdzad 2pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shigapya /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di tshul shing 'brim par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong gyad bu nor la dge slong ma mdza' — mos yang dag pa ma lags pa gsob gsog brdzun gyis skur te/ bdag la dge slong dag gis gzhi 'dis ④gleng bas bdag dge slong gyad bu nor dge 'dun las dran pas 'dul ba gsol na/thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag dge slong gyad bu nor la dran pas 'dul ba stsal du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong gyad bu nor 'di la dge slong ma mdza' mos yang dag pa ma lags pa gsob gsog brdzun gyes skur te/ 'di la dge 'dun gyis phyagazhi des gleng bas dge slong gyad bu nor 'di dge 'dun las dran pas 'dul ba gsol na gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun kyis dge slong gyad bu nor 'di la dran pas 'dul ba spyod kyeto/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong gyad bu nor 'di la dge slong ma mdza' mos yang dag pa ma lags pa gsob gsog brdzun gyis skur te/ 'di la dge slong dag gis gzhi des gleng bas dge slong gyad bu nor 'di la dge 'dun las dran pas 'dul ba gsol te/ de'i slad du 88—1467

dge 'dun gyi rmyedage slong gyad bu nor 'di la dran pas 'dul ba stsol phya na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong gyad bu nor 'di la dran pas 'dul ba sprul bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyes bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong gyad bu nor la dran pas 'dul ba sprul lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol / bdag dge slong bye ma skyes thrus pa sems 'khrugs pa sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas gzir bas dge spyong gi tshul ma lags pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma lags pa / rung ba ma lags pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma lags pa mang du spyod tsacing smras te stsal nas mig 'gyurasnye/ kha chu zags/ bzhin bsgyur/ sa la 'gres ldogasace/ gnyid kyis ma log kyang gnyid kyis log pa ltar bcos/ ma smyos kyang smyos pa ltar bcos/ smra bar ma bsams kyang smras te/ bdag gis dran pa rnyed na bdag la dge slong rnams kyis gzhi des gleng bas bdag dge slong bye ma skyes dge 'dun la ma smyos pas 'dul ba gsol na/ thugs brtse ba can dke 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag dge slong bye ma skyes la ma smyos pas 'dul ba stsal du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong bye ma skyes smyos pa sems 'khrugs pa snyug bsngal gyi tshor bas gzir ba 'dis dge spyong gi tshul ma lags pa/rjes su mthun pa ma 7lags pa/ rung ba ma lags pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma lags pa mang du spyad cing smras te stsal nas mig 'gyurabye/ kha chu zags/88—1468

bzhin bsgyur/ sa la 'gres ldogs/ gnyid 1kyis ma log kyang gnyid kyis log pa ltar bcos/ ma sbyos kyang smyos pa ltar bcos/ smra bar ma bsams kyang smras te/ 'dis dran pa rnyed na 'di la dge slong rnams kyis gzhi des gleng bas dge slong bye ma skyes 'di dge 'dun las ma smyos par k+ṣe'adul ba gsol na/gal te dge 'dun kyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong bye ma skyes la ma smyos pas 'dul ba stsol to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/dge slong bye ma skyes smyos pa ༄ sems 'khrugs pa/ snyug bsngal gyi tshor bas gzir ba 'dis dge sbyong gi tshul ma lags pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma lags pa/rung ba ma lags pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma lags pa/ mang du spyad cing smras te sprul pyanas mig 'gyur snye/ kha chu zags/ bzhin bsgyur/ sa la 'gres ldogs / gnyid trekyis ma log 51kyang gnyid kyis log 8pa ltar bcos/ ma sbyos kyang sbyos pa ltar bcos/ smra bar ma bsams kyang smras te/ 'dis dran pa rnyed na 'di la dge slong rnams kyis gzhi des gleng bas dge slong bye ma skyes 'di dge 'dun las ma smyos pas 'dul ba gsol te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun kyis dge slong bye ma skyes la ma smyos pas 'dul ba gsol na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong bye ma skyes la ma smyos pas/ 'dul ba sprul bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong bye ma skyes la ma smyos pas 'dul ba stsal lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin 88—1469

du 'dzin to/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang dag bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas 'thab par gyur/ mtshang 3'bru bar gyur/ rtsod par gyur/ 'gyed par gyur cing gnas te/ phyogs dang gzhan gyi phyogs su rnam par gnas pa ni bdag cag gis ma rnyed de/ rnyed pa ma yin no/ /nyes pa rnyed kyi ri —legs par rnyed pa ni — —ma yin no/ /kha na ma tho ba spom po dang khyim na gnas pa la ston pa ma gtogs par gzhi 'di las khyod la ltung ba byung ba gang yin pa dang /bdag la ldung ba byung ba gang yin pa de dag tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gi mdun du mthol ba dang / 'chags pa dang / mi 'chab par bdag spro'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag 4bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas 'thab par gyur/ mtshang 5'bru bar gyur/ rtsod par gyur/ 'gyed par gyur cing gnas te/ phyogs dang gzhan gyi phyogs su rnam par gnas pa ni bdag cag gis ma rnyed de/ rnyed pa ma yin no/ /nyes pa rnyed kyi 6legs pa ma rnyed de7/ kha na ma tho ba spom po dang / khyem na gnas pa la ston pa ma gtogs par gzhi 'di las khyed cag la ltung ba byung ba gang yin pa dang / bdag snal ltung ba byung ba gang yin pa de dag tshe dang ldan pa dag gi mdun du bdag mthol lo/ /bshags 17so/ /—mi 'chab bo/ /mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur ro/ /ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro/ /lan gsum du bzlas/ thong ba mthong ngam/ mthong ngo / /phyin cad sdom mam/ sdom mo/ /lan gsum du bzlas/rtsod pa'i gzhi'o// //gnas mal kyi gzhi dang nye ba'i gzhi'i sdom la/ gnas khang zas la bsko 88byed/ /70

ba gnyis/ /thug pa bag chos 'brim pa gnyis/ /phran tshegs 'brim par byed pa gnyisatsa/ /snod spyad 2'brub dang gos kyi gnyis/ /dbyar gyi ras chen sbed dang 'gyedathu/ /mngag gzhug pa dang mdzes chos ༄te/ /gang zag bcu dang gnyis po dag /ston pas yang dag bshad pa yin/ /lag gi bla dang lag dpon dang / /'khar ba dang ni dra ba'o/ /ming 'di zhes bgyi ba khyod dge slong lhags pa lhags pa rnams la gnas khang bsko bar spyo'am/ spro'o/ /cho dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ /dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge slong lhags pa lhags pa rnams la gnas khang bsko bar spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba gnas khang bsko bar spro bar sgo bgyi ste/ dge slong ming 3zhes bgyi ba 'di dge slong lhags pa lhags pa rnams la gnas khang bsko'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge slong lhags pa lhags pa rnams la gnas khang bsko bar 8spro ste/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di 1gnas khang bsko bar nyu spro na tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba gnas khang bsko bar bsko ba /1bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di 1 gnas khang bsko bar bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod dge slong rnams la zas la bsko bar spro'am/ spro'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge 88—1171

slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge slong rnams la zas la bsko bar spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab byung bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di 1dge slong rnams la zas la bsko bar bgyi ste/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge slong rnams la zas la bsko'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge slong rnams la zas la bsko bar spro ste dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di ldudage slong rnams la zas la bsko bar bskos na tshe dang ldan pa dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di 1dge slong rnams la zas la bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyes dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge slong rnams la zas la bsko bar bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas 4de de bzhin du 'dze+en to/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khyed dge slong rnams la thug pa 'brim par spyo'am/ spro'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol / dge slong ming 'di zhes bkyi ba 'di dge slong rnams la thug pa 'brim par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun kyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun kyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun kyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di thudage 'dun rnams la thug pa 'brim par bsko bar bgyi ste/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge slong rnams la thug pa 'brim mo/ /'di ni gsol ba'o / /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge slong rnams la thug pa 'brim par spro ste/ dge slong ming 88—1 /72

bzod pa la 'khar ba k+ṇiganang ba sprul to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di rgas 'khogs shing nyam chung la bro 'tshal zhing 3spyor mi bzod de/ dge 'dun la bye 'khar ba gnang ba gsol na/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rgas 'khogs shing nyam chung la bro 'tshal zhing spyor mi bzod ④la 'khar ba'i phyoganang ba gsol na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di trergas 'khogs shing nyam chung la bro 'tshal zhing spyor mi bzod dzol 'khar ba gnang ba sprul bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas / dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rgas 'khogs shing nyam chung la 3bro 'tshal zhing sbyor mi bzod pa la 'khar ba gnang ba stsal lags te/'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba rgas 'khogs shing nyam chung ba ḍabro 'tshal zhing spyor mi bzod de/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kye las dra ba gnang ba gsol na/ thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rgas 'khogs shing nyam chung la bro 'tshal zhing spyor mi bzod pa la dra ba gnang ba pa du gsol/ lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol—/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rgas 'khogs shing nyam chung la bro 'tshal zhing sbyor mi bzod pa 'di dge 'dun las dra ba gnang ba nyucegasol na/gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar 88—1481

mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyes dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rgas 'khogs shing nyam chung la bro 'tshal zhing spyor mi bzod pa la dra ba gnang ba sprul to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rgas 'khogs shing nyam chung la bro 'tshal zhing thrur mi bzod de/ dge 'dun las dra ba gnang ba gsol nalju/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rgas 'khogs shing nyam chung la bro 'tshal zhing sbyor mi bzod pa la dra ba gnang ba gsol khyen/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rgas 'khogs shing nyam chung la bro 'tshal zhing sbyor mi bzod pa la dra ba gnang ba stsal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun kyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rgas 'khogs shing nyam chung la bro 'tshal zhing sbyor mi bzod pa la dra ba gnang ba stsal lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /'khar ba 4dang dra ba gnyis ka'i gnang ba sbyin pa ni las snga ma gnyis ka'i khongs su 'dus so/ /gnas mal gyi gzhi dang nye ba'i gzhi'o// //las kyi grangs brgya 5rtsa gcig tu nges par gang 6las shes she na/ gtam gyi gzhi las las kyi 7grangs brjod pa la/ btsun pa las dag tu mchis/ nye ba 'khor brgya rtsa gabyug go/ /btsun pa las du dag gis las thams cad bsdus / nye ba 'khor gsum kyis te/ gsum gang zhe na/ gsol ba'i las dang / gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las dang / gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyis so/ /88—1482

btsun pa las brgya rtsa gcig po gang dag lags pa de dag ni gsol ba'i las dag ni du/ gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las dag ni du/ gsol ba dang bzhi'i las dag ni du mchis bka' sprul pa nye ba tshosna'akhor/ gsol ba'i las ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o / /gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las ni bzhi bcu rtsa bdun no/ /gsol ba dang bzhi'i las ni sum cu'o zhes gsungs so/ /de las gsol ba'i las nyi shu rtsa bzhi gang zhe na/ gal te rngugasang ste ston pa'i slob dpon gyis bar chad kyi chos rnams gsang ste dri ba'i phyir gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / las byed pa'i slob dpon gyis bar chad kyi chos rnams dge 'dun gyi nang du dri ba'i phyir gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / so sor thar pa'i mdo gdon pa'i phyir gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / gso sbyong de la dge 'dun thams cad rtsang ba dang bcas par gyur na gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / gso sbyong gi tshe ldung ba de la dge 'dun thams cad yid gnyis dang bcas par gyur na gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / gso spyong gi tshe dge 'dun ltung ba'i phyir rtsod par gyur na gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / gso sbyong gi tshe ltung ba de ni gang yin pa de las ji ltar ni ldang bar 'gyur zhes bya ba la sogs pas nyes pa nyid 4ma yin par gyur na de'i tshe gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / dgag dbye 3bya ba'i phyir gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang /dgag dbye de la dge 'dun thams cad ltung ba dang bcas par gyur na gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi 6las bya ba dang / dgag dbye'i tshe ltung ba de la dge 'dun thams cad yid gnyis dang bcas par gyur na gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / dgag dbye'i tshe dge 'dun ldung ba'i phyir rtsod par gyur na gsol ba 88—1483

'ba' zhig gi hūṃlas bya ba dang / dgag dbye'i tshe ltung ba de ni gang yin de las ji ltar ni ldang bar 'gyur zhes bya ba la sogs pas nges pa nyid ma yin par gyur na de'i tshe gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / dbyar gnas par khas blang ba'i tshe gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / shi ba'i rdzas dang / shi ba'i nor dang 'dra ba'i gang zag byin gyis brlab zupa la gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyis chos gos sra brkyang de gding ba'i 4dge slong la gtad pa dang / gyad bu nor lta bu chos gos gsum ngan pa la dge 'dun kyis ras yug chen sbyin pa la gsol ba khya'aba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / dge slong dang dge slong ma gang dag ji ltar skye bo phal po che'i tshogs ma dad par rig par 'gyur ba de lta hūṃde ltar khyim rnams su spyod par byed pa 7khyem rnams su so sor go bar byed du gzhug pa la gsol ba byesna'aba' zhig gi phyolas bya ba dang / ngor 'phya ba'i grangs su gzhug pa la gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / gzhogs 'phyas byed pa'i grangs su gzhug pa la gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi 'a/sa bya ba dang / bsgo ba rna la gzon pa'i grangs hūṃsu gzhug pa la gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / cang mi smra bas rna la gzon pa'i grangs su/ gzhug pa la gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / sbyin bdag longs spyod 'gribs pa'i khyim du zan mi bza' ba'i sdom pa sbyin pa la gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / khyem kyi sdom pa byin pa de nyid gzhig pa la gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / khyim bdag dge slong la yang dag pa ma yin pas sgur pa 'debs pa'i khyim du lhung bzed khas dbub 7pa la gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba dang / lhung bzed khas phub pa de nyid bzod pa gsol 88—1484

ba'i khyim du de nyid lkubazlog par bya ba la gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba'orngu/ /gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bzhi bcu rtsa bdun gang zhe na/ gso spyong gi gnas la blo mthun par 3bya ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor pa dang / mtshams chen po gcad pa 4dang / mtshams bu chung bcad pa la thugasol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / mtshams chen po bcad pa'i nang du chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong byos shing sems 'khrug gyopa las kyi gnas su rad rod byed pa mi mthun par mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye byed pa'i dge slong bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dbyar gnas par khas len pa rnams la gnas mal stobs pa'i dge slong bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / rung ba'i khang pa la blo mthun par bya ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi 7sra brkyang la blo mthun par bya ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang /dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'ding ba'i dge slong bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / spong ba'i zhal ta byed pa bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / lag gi bla dang lag pod bsko ba la gsol ba ④gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / gnas khang ༄9bsko ba la gsol ba dang steganyis kyi las bya ba dang / zas la bsko bar bsko ba la gsol ba dang skyoganyis kyi las bya ba dang / thug pa 'brim pa bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang /bag chos 'brim pa bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / phran 88—1486

tshegs 'brim pa bsko ba la gsol ba dang sneganyis kyi las bya ba dang / snod spyad 'brim 'epa bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dbyar gyi gos kyi rnyed pa sbed pa bsko zhe ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dbyar gyi gos kyi rnyed pa 'gyed pa bsko ba la gsol ba dang saganyis kyi las bya ba dang /dbyar gyi gos ras chen sbed pa 9bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang /dbyar gyi gos ras chen 'gyed pa bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / mngag gzhug par )bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang /mdzes 'chos bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba mngon sum gyis 'dul ba'i gzu bo bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba gzu bos zhi bar ma nus na dge 'dun nam gzu bo rnams kyis rtsod pa de zhi bar byed pa'i gang zag gsal ba dang gsal ba'i yang gsal ba bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang /dge 'dun la rtsod pa byung ba gang zag gsal ba — dang gsal ba'i rnguyang gsal bas zhi bar ma nus te dge 'dun la phul ba na dge 'dun gyis rtsod pa sbed pa'i gang zag bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge 'dun rtsod pa byung ba'i tshe tshul shing 'brim pa'i 1gang zag bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong khang pa'i gzhi rung ba bstan par / gsol ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong gtsug lag khang gi gzhi rung ba bstan pa gsol ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong khyem sun 'byin pa la dge spyong gi chos ma yin pa rnam pa mang pos gleng ba'i gang zag bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / rgan po dang nad pa 88—1486

la chos gos rmyesnam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong lag gi bla la lo drug tshun chad du stan gyi gnang ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / lhung bzed 'brel pa med par 'brim pa'i gang zag bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong dang dge slong ma skye bo 37phal po che ma dad par rig par 'gyur ba de ltar khyem rnams su so sor go bar byed pa'i gang zag bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong ma'i ston pa bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / so sor bshags pa'i nyes pa spang ba'i phyir gang zag nags nyul ba bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang /dge slong dge 'dun gyi — gnas nas phyung ba la dge slong mas phyag bya ba'i 'os ma yin pa'i sdom pa sbyin pa la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong ma 'khor skyong nus pa la 'khor nye bar 'jog pa'i gnang ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong ma 'khor skyong nus pa dang lo bcu gnyis lon chopa la 'khor mang po nye bar 'jog pa'i gnang 5ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong rgan po dang nad pa la 'khar ba gnang ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong rgan po dang na ba la dra ba gnang ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang /gtsug lag khang mtshams tha dad pa gnyis kyi rnyed pa gcig tu bya ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong ma'i bslab pa'i sdom pa sbyin pa la gsol ba dang ༄ snaganyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong ma bsnyen par sdogs par bya ba la dz+watshangs par spyod pa la nye bar gnas pa'i sdom pa sbyin pa la gsol ba 88—1487

dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong ma bu dang lhan cig khyim gcig na nyal ba'i gnang ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang / dge slong ma lhamu ge'i sdug bsngal byung ba'i tshe nye du rnams dang lhan cig 'brel ba'i nye bar spyod pa'i ༄ snaganang ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba dang /dbyar gnas par khas blangs pa dge 'dun gyi tshad snyel zhag bzhi bcu mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'gro ba'i gnang ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya ba'o④/ /gsol ba dang bzhi'i las sum cu gang zhe na/ dge slong dang dge slong ma bsnyen par sgogs par bya ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / mu stegs can rab tu 'byung bar 'dod pa zla ba bzhi'i bar du mkhan pos sbyar ba'i gos kyi spuganas pa 'usbyin pa la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor pa dang / mtshams chen po dang / mtshams bu chung dgrol ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / gnas nas phyung ba bzod pa'i las byas pa mthun pa sbyin pa la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / mthun pa byin pa la 3mthun pa'i gso sbyong sbyin pa la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / nan tur gyi las bsdigs pa dang / smad pa dang / bskrad pa dang / phyir 'gyed pa dang /ma mthong bas gnas nas dbyung ba dang / phyir mi 'chos pas gnas nas dbyung ba dang / sdig pa can gyi lta ba'i rnam pa mi gtong bas gnas nas dbyung ba dang // gso sbyong gzhag pa dang / dgag dbye gzhag par bya ba dag la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang/ de dag la bzod pa bya ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / bya ba dag la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang spu/spo ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / bhegazhi nas spo ba sbyin pa 88—1488

la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / yang gzhi nas bslang ste spo ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / yang gzhi nas babe+eng ste mgu bar bya ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / dge 'dun lhag ma'i lcung ba byung hūṃb la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / sra brkyang dbyung ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / ma byos pas 'dul ba sbyin pa la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug pa sbyin 2la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / dge 'dun kyi dbyen byed pa bzlog pa'i phyir bsgo ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / de'i sde rjes su phyogs pa bzlog pa'i phyir bsgo ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / khyim sun 'byin pa bzlog pa'i phyir bsgo ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / bka' blo mi bde ba bzlog pa'i phyir bsgo ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / dge slong dang dge tshul sdig pa can kyi lta ba'i rnam pa mi gtong ba bzlog pa'i phyir bsgo ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / gnas nas phyung ba'i rjes su phyogs pa'i dge slong ma bzlog pa'i phyir bsgo ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang /dge slong ma dkon mchog gtong ba bzlog pa'i phyir bsgo ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / dge slong ma 'thab grol byed pa bzlog pa'i phyir bsgo ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / dge slong ma sde zhing gnas pa bzlog chopa'i phyir bsgo ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / dge slong ma sde zhing gnas su 'dzud pa bzlog pa'i phyir bsgo ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang /88—1489

dge tshul sdig pa can gyi lta ba'i rnam pa mi gtong ba bsnyil ba la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba dang / pham par 'gyur ba'i thong ba byung ba la bslab pa sbyin pa la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya ba'o/ /las rnams kyi bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni 'di dag yin te/ gsang dang nang du dri phyir dang / /gso sbyong de la ltung bcas dang / /de la dge 'dun yid gnyis dang / /rtsod dang nges nyid ma yin dang / /de yi don du lnga po dag /thams cad dgag dbyer gtogs pa yin/ /dbyar gnas khas blangs khyenyid dang ni/ /shi ba'i dzas dang nor 'dra dang / /chos gos sra brkyang gtad pa dang / /chos gos sbyin par bya ba dang / /gnas ngan len ni brjod pa dang / /grangs su gzhug pa bzhi dag dang / /khyim gyi sdom dang de gzhig dang / /lhung bzed khas dbub bya ba dang / /de nyid bzlog par bya ba dag /gsol ba 'ba' zhig las yin no / /gnas dang mtshams ni gsum po dang / /mi 'bral smyos dang dgag dbye dang / /gnas mal stobs par byed pa dang / /rung ba'i 27sa gzhi bsgo ba dang / /sra brkyang dang ni de 'ding dang / /spong dang lag gi bla dang ni/ /gnas khang bsko la sogs pa dang / /gzu dang gsal dang sbed pa dang / /tshul shing 'brim par byed pa dang / /khang pa khang chen bstan pa dang / /gleng dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur dang / /stan dang lhung bzed 'brim pa dang / /ma dad go bar bya ba dang / /ston pa dang ni nags nyul dang / /phyag mi bya dang mang phyir dang / /'khar ba dra ba'i phyir dang ni/ /rnyed pa gcig tu bya phyir dang / /bslab pa sbyin dang nye ༄gnas dang / /bu dang nye du'i phyir 'gro ba/ /gsol ba choganyis kyi las yin no/ /bsnyen par rdzogs par bya ba dang / /mu 88byed1490

stegs gnas dang mtshams dgrol dang / /mthun sbyin gso sbyong bdun po dag /brgya hūṃdang dran dang ma smyos dang / /de nyid tshol du gzhug pa dang / /bsgo bar bya ba rnams dang ni/ /nyams pa sbyin par bya ba dag /gsol dang bzhi yi 3 las yin no/ /las brgya rtsa gcig pa/ 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po bram ze'i btsun pa slob dpon yon tan 'od bdag dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i chos 'dul ba bdud rtsi'i nying khus shes rab kyi dbang po rgyas pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dam pa nan tan snying por bsgrubs pa3/ sde pa thams cad kyi 'dul ba'i sde snod mtha' dag gi gtso bor ④gyur pa/ 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba kun las btus pa rdzogs so// //dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag dpal lha btsan po'i bka' lung gis 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa kha che'i bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'di la sh+lau ka deni sum stong bdun brgya yod/ bam po ni dgur byas so// //688—1491

bldur mchan/11 ༷ 5 skyematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la ra /las brgya rtsa slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa'o/ /zhes 'khod/ gye 〈〈co 11dang mkhan po 12dang / /chos gos gnyis 13dang lhung bzed 1zhenang / /sgo bya gsol ba 15gsang ston 16dang / /zhu 17dang gsol 18dang gsol ba 19dang / /dri 20dang las 21dang grib tshod 22dang / /nyin
